title: a name typed on the title goes into a new save
why: His order (2026-10-18): if he types a name into the name box on the title and then clicks create a new save, the new save should have that name. The button reloads the game onto an empty slot and a fresh save was always named PILLAGER, so the typed name was dropped. The typed name now rides along with the reload and the fresh save takes it as it boots, only for that slot, only once, only a save with no raids.
now: Type a name on the title and click create a new save: the new save has that name.
